Decompose each of the 48 spherical order chambers at x=y+z into two spherical triangles, and apply integration by parts using Laplace–Beltrami identities Delta(u_i)=-2u_i and Delta(u_i u_j)=2 delta_ij-6u_i u_j; the explicit boundary side formulas reconstruct the exact mixed moments. Their exact radical/arctangent combinations yield cov_O=2/3+(4sqrt(2)+8omega-6sqrt(6)theta)/pi>0 and cov_T=8/3+8sqrt(6)/pi-12sqrt(6)(pi/2-theta)/pi<0.
